title: Photographs of underground treasure cavern

tellings.quote: I've seen photographs of of the I mean it looks it's like a football stadium down underneath the ground, you know,

plain: In the Philippines around 1945, there was an underground cavern full of treasure, so large it looked "like a football stadium" beneath the ground. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels he has seen photographs of it himself, and if they are what he says, a huge hidden hoard was stored under the islands at the end of the war.
